problem_statement: Build a brand-new Analytics view at the route /analytics on the technext V-Dashboard template (Vue 3 + Vite + vue-router with createWebHistory, Tailwind CSS 2). The route does not exist yet (baseline renders an empty page). Construct the full page from scratch reusing the site's existing design system (the DashboardLayout sidebar/header chrome, the bg-white rounded-md shadow-sm card style, gray-700 headings and indigo-600 accent used across Dashboard/Cards/Tables). The page must include: (1) an 'Analytics' page heading (h3) with a one-line intro paragraph; (2) a four-card stats strip showing Sessions, Bounce rate, Avg. session and Conversions; (3) a report card containing a real tabbed interface with three tab buttons - Traffic Sources, Top Pages, Devices. The Traffic Sources tab is active on first paint and shows a 'Traffic overview' heading, an intro paragraph, and a channel breakdown list. Clicking the 'Top Pages' tab must reveal a 'Top landing pages' section (h3) that is NOT present on the default Traffic Sources view. The page must be responsive with no horizontal overflow on mobile. Register /analytics in src/router.ts so it renders inside the DashboardLayout (default layout).
required_content: 'Analytics' page heading (h3) plus a one-line intro paragraph starting 'Monitor traffic'
Stats strip: four cards labelled Sessions (24,318), Bounce rate (38.2%), Avg. session (3m 12s) and Conversions (1,204)
A report card wrapping a tabbed interface with three tab buttons: Traffic Sources, Top Pages, Devices (each carrying a data-tab attribute)
Traffic Sources tab (default/active): a 'Traffic overview' heading (h3), a paragraph starting 'Organic search drives', and a channel breakdown list (Organic search / Direct / Referral / Social)
Top Pages tab: a 'Top landing pages' section (h3) with a ranked pages list, hidden until the Top Pages tab is clicked (rendered with v-if)
Devices tab: a 'Device breakdown' section (h3) with a desktop/mobile/tablet split
Responsive layout that stacks on mobile with no horizontal overflow
design_constraints: Render inside the existing DashboardLayout (default layout) so the sidebar and header chrome are inherited
Reuse the site's Tailwind design tokens: bg-white rounded-md shadow-sm cards, text-gray-700 headings, text-gray-500/600 body, indigo-600 accents, the flex flex-wrap -mx grid pattern
The active tab must be driven by a reactive ref with @click handlers; hidden tab panels use v-if so their content is absent until selected
author_notes: Scheme A: baseline registers /analytics as a top-level empty route with meta.layout='empty' (renders a bare empty div, no chrome) so check A sees an empty route; reference implements the full page with a working v-if tab interaction; bad renders inert tab buttons (no @click, active hardcoded) with ALL three panels always stacked/rendered, so 'Top landing pages' is already present on first paint and the changed_from interaction delta cannot hold. Router uses createWebHistory so state_plan paths are plain /analytics. NOTE: the upstream repo's router.ts imports ./views/NotFound.vue which does not exist in the tree (pre-existing broken import that fails vue-tsc --noEmit); it was replaced identically in all three workspaces (baseline->AnalyticsEmpty, reference/bad->Analytics) so the vue-tsc && vite build passes. Three workspace source trees are md5-distinct.

_build_meta.install: (corepack enable && corepack yarn install --frozen-lockfile) || npm install
